title: Submission
purpose: Review your shipment and declared samples, submit it for laboratory review, and follow acceptance and receipt.
summary: One sample submission: the shipment, the samples you declared, and where it stands with the laboratory, from your draft to receipt.

tasks.title: Declare the samples
steps: Select [[Add sample]] and enter its collection details, intended tests and containers.
Repeat for each sample. Use [[Edit]] to change the shipment or project details.

tasks.title: Send the submission to the laboratory
steps: Check every sample has tests and containers.
Select [[Submit to laboratory]]. The version is frozen and editing is locked while the laboratory reviews it.

tasks.title: Make the changes the laboratory asked for
steps: Read the laboratory's note at the top or under Submitted versions.
Edit the details or samples, then select [[Submit to laboratory]] again.

tasks.title: Discard a draft you no longer need
steps: Select [[Delete draft]] and confirm. The draft and all its samples are deleted; this cannot be undone.

good_to_know: Submitting does not record a receipt. Lab status shows Received as only after the laboratory physically receives a sample.
Accepted means the laboratory expects the samples. It does not mean any sample has arrived.
Samples not yet collected can be submitted. Actual collection details are confirmed at receipt.
Only a draft that was never submitted can be deleted. A cancelled submission cannot be reinstated by you; contact the laboratory.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Sign in with an active client account. Every page, selection and action is limited to the client attached to your account, including work created by other users for the same client. Staff accounts cannot use these portal pages. Another client’s record is treated as missing.

items.label: Submission / Project / COC
items.description: SUB number, current project and chain-of-custody reference identify the shipment.

items.label: Quote
items.description: If linked, opens the accepted quote for this work.

items.label: Draft
items.description: Editable and not yet sent.

items.label: Returned
items.description: Displays what the laboratory asked you to correct. Edit details or samples and submit again; the prior submitted version remains frozen.

items.label: With the laboratory
items.description: Submitted time and review status. Editing is locked while the laboratory reviews.

items.label: Accepted
items.description: Laboratory opened intake and expects the samples. Does not mean any sample has physically arrived.

items.label: Cancelled
items.description: Laboratory marked the shipment as not arriving. Contact them if you still plan to send it; clients cannot reinstate it.

items.label: Not collected yet
items.description: Count of samples without actual collection time. Ask the laboratory for planned bottle labels while preparing; actual collection details are confirmed at receipt.

items.label: Expected arrival
items.description: Planned arrival date or Not stated.

items.label: Carrier / tracking
items.description: Transport/tracking text or a dash.

items.label: Coolers / packages
items.description: Declared shipment package count; not verified at receipt. A dash is shown when blank or zero.

items.label: Contact
items.description: Declared name and phone for shipment questions.

items.label: Instructions
items.description: Your special instructions; no automatic approval or configured limit follows from this text.

sections.title: Samples
paragraphs: The sample list is ordered by its declared position and has no filtering, sorting or pagination. Up to 200 samples can be declared. No samples yet offers Add sample.

items.label: Your sample ID
items.description: Client identifier; opens editing only while Draft or Returned for changes.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Water, Wastewater or Soil, followed by the sample source when you declared one. Beneath it: Grab or Composite, and the sample type when it is not an ordinary field sample (for example Field duplicate or Trip blank).

items.label: Collected
items.description: Actual declared collection/end time or Not collected yet with optional planned date. Composite start is retained in the sample form but not displayed in this table.

items.label: Location · collector
items.description: Declared collection place and collector.

items.label: Tests
items.description: Number of intended test definitions, not completed analyses.

items.label: Containers
items.description: Total individual containers across all declared types, including quantities.

items.label: Lab status
items.description: Received as plus laboratory sample ID after physical receipt; Expected for an accepted unreceived sample; otherwise a dash. This is receipt status, not analysis or report status.

sections.title: Submitted versions
paragraphs: Before first submission, Not submitted yet explains that versions appear after sending. The staff audit timeline is not shown in the client portal.

items.label: Version
items.description: Number of each frozen submission, oldest first. These rows are informational; the client page does not open historical snapshot contents.

items.label: Submitted
items.description: Timestamp the client sent that version.

items.label: Outcome
items.description: Awaiting review, Returned or Accepted for that version. Shipment cancellation does not change an earlier Accepted outcome.

items.label: Note
items.description: Laboratory correction note when returned, otherwise a dash.

sections.title: Actions
paragraphs: A changed revision refuses submission or removal. Reload and review the current contents before trying again. Successful actions show a message. Retrying a completed submit does not create another snapshot.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Open shipment/project fields while Draft or Returned for changes.

items.label: Add sample
items.description: Add collection details, intended tests and containers while editable.

items.label: Remove
items.description: Only while editable. Opens Remove sample confirmation. Confirm to remove that sample and its tests/containers; Cancel closes without removal. It can be added again before resubmitting. Stale removals are refused; a repeated already-completed removal is harmless.

items.label: Submit to laboratory
items.description: Only while editable. Requires an active client/project, nonblank COC reference and at least one sample, with tests and containers for each. Tests must still be active and match each sample’s matrix. Uncollected planned samples are allowed. Freeze a new numbered snapshot and lock client editing pending review. No physical receipt is recorded.

items.label: Delete draft
items.description: Only a Draft never previously submitted. Opens confirmation that deletes the draft and all entered samples/tests/containers; this cannot be undone. Cancel keeps it. The audit event remains. Returned or previously submitted records cannot be deleted this way. If you delete a draft in one window while another window still shows it, saving, removing a sample or submitting in the other window returns you to Submissions with the message that the draft was deleted; nothing is saved.

items.label: Submissions
items.description: Return to the client directory.
